<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$box = new stdClass;
$box->mark = 7;
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): OBJECT {
        global $box;
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return false; }
        return $box;
    }
};
$selector = "box";
$destination = 42;
echo $reader->$selector === $box ? "IDENTITY;" : "BAD_IDENTITY;";
$reader->drop;
echo "DROP;";
try { $destination = $reader->bad === $box; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "box" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
function objectReviewRight() { echo "RHS;"; return null; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming) {
        global $reader;
        echo "GET;";
        $result = $reader;
        $reader = null;
        return $result;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
};
echo $reader->alias === objectReviewRight() ? "BAD_OBJECT;" : "OBJECT;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class ObjectReviewPayload {
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; throw new Exception("payload-object"); }
}
$payload = new ObjectReviewPayload;
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(string $incoming): mixed {
        global $reader, $payload;
        echo "GET;";
        $result = $payload;
        $payload = null;
        $reader = null;
        return $result;
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        echo "RECEIVER;";
        throw new Exception("receiver-object");
    }
};
try { $reader->gone; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo "DONE;";
